It smells faintly sweet. You have never seen this fruit before in your life. You have no phone to search. No book to check. No one nearby who knows what it is. Do you eat it or walk away. That is not a hypothetical question. That was a real decision ancient humans made thousands of times across thousands of generations. And the wrong answer did not mean an upset stomach.
